note: Fibonacci retracements and Gann eighths for 399 stocks, each with the number of times price actually reached it and how often that touch was followed by a reversal of 1% or more within 5 sessions. Below 20 touches the rate is withheld.

cautions.description_not_prediction: A respect rate describes the past. It is not a promise that the level holds next time.
cautions.closes_only: Built from closing prices, so a touch means the close came within 0.3% of the level. Intraday wicks are invisible here.
cautions.withheld_below_20: A rate over fewer than 20 touches is noise and is published as null, not as a number.
cautions.no_astrology: Gann eighths and Fibonacci ratios are arithmetic on a price range. Nothing here uses planetary positions or dates.
